faqs.q: Sec. 26-3. - Biennial review and update of emergency operations plan (basic plan).
faqs.a:
The city council shall biennially review the emergency operations plan (basic plan)
               upon a presentation by the city manager and community resilience coordinator. The
               biennial review of the emergency operations plan by city council shall occur in executive
               session or by other means as permitted by state law which protect the confidentiality
               and security of the city's emergency operations and procedures.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
